# P1.10 — Draft workflow: the Draft verb end-to-end (port + plan gate + bounded re-plan + drafting note)

Spec: `docs/tickets/38_P1.10__draft-workflow.md` · run ledger: `docs/build/runs/P1.10.md`
**Stage A only** — all code + deterministic tests. Stage B (deploy `api`/`run-task`/`web` to `dev`,
bounded live Draft run incl. the ≈60-cr preview) is operator-gated → **D-P1.10-1**.

## Summary

The Draft verb now runs end-to-end. `draft-from-outline` is vendored at upstream pin
`5fef4165` (drift-checked: 22 ported files, sanctioned edits only). A new eight-phase
`WORKFLOW_MANIFESTS.draft` drives intake → voice → plan → grounding → draft → consolidation →
audit → delivery, with the §12.2 `grounding → plan` back-edge. Approve plan binds to the real
`02-structure-plan.md` and rides P1.09's structured-overlay machinery (`spine_min ≥ 3` oracle).
The Writing phase streams `section.drafted{sectionRef,words,budget}` events in plan order —
emitted from the committed `04-draft-ledger.md`, deduped on `sectionRef`, never from pod text.
Grounding failures marked `replan` reset the plan + later committed steps and feed the failure
back into the re-run as `inputs.replan`; `ITERATION_CAPS.replan = 2` is enforced — the (cap+1)-th
failure opens a blocking `refusal` Approval and parks `waiting_gate` (never a silent continue).
Delivery creates a born-frozen `drafted_from_outline` v(N+1) draft row whose promoted head is the
Writing phase's committed `drafts/vN.md` (fail-closed if absent) plus the `drafting_note`
correspondence. The estimator gains the Draft row (60 + 0.05·words + 11·claims + churn, grounding
addend, preview variant) and the run-sheet `DRAFT` profile (grounding/audit toggles; Quick drops
both). The trial first-section preview (`preview:{sections:1}`) forces grounding/audit off, prices
the ≈60-cr variant, and pre-resolves Approve plan `by:'trial'`. Run creation reserves
`nextDraftId`/`nextDraftN` server-side and 400s a missing/foreign outline.
